page.overview:
Who is Angry Mom?

The angry mom is a resident of Springfield who shops at the Kwik-E-Mart. After a television broadcast revealed the unsanitary practices which Apu Nahasapeemapetilon carried out, she expressed her anger at Apu, calling him a "monster" and told her children to run for it.
